news.headline: Neubrain to Feature at 116th GFOA Conference
Neubrain to Sponsor GFOA 2021 Virtual Annual Conference
Neubrain Recognized for Contributions in Budgeting

paragraphs: Neubrain sells pre-packaged budgeting, planning and business analytics software applications, and describes its work as linking budget decisions with strategic outcomes. The solutions are organized by initiative and cover performance-based budgeting, pay and personnel budgeting, operating budget, capital budget, forecasting, performance measurement and cost allocation. Under technology, the pages list business analytics software, performance management software, interactive visualization and dashboards, and data integration software.

The pages group buyers by industry, naming the Department of Defense, federal, state and local government, nonprofits and authorities, and manufacturing. The company says it has collaborated with federal, state, and local governments, as well as Global 5000 and medium-sized companies. Case studies on the customers page name the Housing Authority of Baltimore City, the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, North Collier Fire Rescue District and the State of Hawaii. The same page also lists private-sector customers, among them Buffalo Wild Wings, JJ Haines & Company.

quote.text: Whenever you need to analyze, budget, forecast, measure, and report, Neubrain can help.
